text:
morgan: quick heads-up — spotted two broken anchors in the runtime guide and one curl example returning 404. small patch ok to fix anchors + example?
claire: can you paste the curl output so i can see what the 404 looks like?
morgan: sure, pasted below:
```
curl -i https://docs.redwood.inference/runtime/kv-cache#how-to
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
Date: Tue, 12 Apr 2026 15:02:03 GMT
```
rajesh: looks like the fragment is right but the slug changed from `runtime/kv-cache` -> `runtime/kv-caching` in the last content sweep. anchors won't auto-redirect.
eva: I can take the anchor renames, fyi changing anchor IDs might break internal links. should we add an inline note in the moved page to help people? @docs-bot any tooling for automated shortlink/anchor redirects?
docs-bot: we have shortlink redirect rules for moved pages (shortlinks preserved) but fragment anchors are not remapped automatically. recommended approach: update inbound references + add a small "migrated anchors" section to the top of the target page. 
jen: if it's a tiny PR (<=5 files) i can review quickly. ping me when it's up. :+1:
morgan: created PR explaining the two anchor renames + fixed curl snippet: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321
ci-bot: CI started for PR#4321 — link-checker running.
ci-bot: link-checker report: 1 remaining dead link at /runtime/batching#fastpath (external refs updated but fragment missing)
claire: i'll take batching anchor after lunch, should be a 10min fix.
jen: will review the PR once batching anchor is fixed, small nit on a code fence style in the snippet.
morgan: thanks! adding a short changelog line and a note in the PR body about the fragment handling.
rajesh: re: process, can we add a tiny checklist to docs PR template reminding to check fragments and run link-checker locally? i can open a follow-up PR for the template.
eva: sounds good, helps avoid churn.
morgan: ok — will merge when jen approves and CI is green. thx all :tada:
